END-TO-END CODEBASE COMPREHENSION, SUBSCRIPTION API POOLING & HARNESS ENABLEMENT STACK (L1 ➔ L4)
1. Interactive Codebase Graph (Understand-Anything ★94.0k): Turn complex legacy repos & docs into interactive teaching graphs for humans & agents.
2. Harness Engineering Upskilling (learn-harness-engineering ★26.0k): Train internal engineers from 0 to 1 on building deterministic agent loops.
3. CLI-to-REST API Adapter (CLIProxyAPI ★59.4k): Expose Claude Code, Codex & Grok Build CLI capabilities as standard OpenAI/Claude REST endpoints.
4. Pooled Subscription Relay (sub2api ★46.5k): Share & load-balance flat-rate subscriptions across teams with Postgres/Redis quota accounting.
CLOSED-FORM FINOPS TCO MODEL (45-ENGINEER PLATFORM, ONBOARDING & GATEWAY TEAM · SYNTHETIC WORKLOAD MODEL)
• Path A (Unpooled Individual Seats + Metered API Overages + Slow Legacy Onboarding): $4,860.00/mo + 46.0h ($4,600.00) = $9,460.00/mo
• Path B (Azure API Management + GitHub Enterprise Seats + Cloud Docs): $1,880.00/mo PaaS + 10.5h ($1,050.00) = $2,930.00/mo
• Path C (Understand-Anything + CLIProxyAPI + sub2api + learn-harness): $65.00/mo + 2.4h ($240.00) = $305.00/mo (Saves $9,155.00/mo · -96.78%)
